properties.name: Alsócsalános
properties.sourceScopeNote: A separately named source cell on Figure78. PDF166–167 distinguishes the residential source quarters, Homokbánya former-barracks quarter and the named Alsócsalános area; the larger Alsószéktó–Homokbánya group is not copied under the four fine source names. The cut-off Alsószéktói kiskertek cell is excluded.
properties.method: Literal original Figure78 maxRGB<=45 black-source-pixel circuits, every dense edge an 8-neighbor source step. Shared dividers are reused exactly; no source-frame closure, label crossing, invented connector, simplification, buffer, snap or repair. Actual photographic texture establishes a Figure79-to-Figure78 image affine relation: fourteen fitted and sixteen separately held-out NCC patches, with no world coordinates, names or boundary rings used by image matching. The inverse image relation is composed with the archived new EOV affine calibration, independently fitted from the five original Figure79 manual source-junction observations and literal OSM coordinates. The frozen Figure79 geographic-degree affine is retained as a model-family comparison and is never modified. Figure78 contours extend beyond the observed common-image overlap and the original calibration image; their full geographic placement is not independently validated. All output is therefore an explicit inferred geographic candidate; exact source contours are proved separately from placement.
properties.sourcePeriod: 2021 May municipal consultation draft; original orthophoto capture date unknown.
properties.license: Municipal source-map reuse rights unverified; ODbL-1.0 for OSM geographical controls and name points.

sourceRaster.coordinateConvention: Integer exact original-image pixel centers, x right/y down, no extra half-pixel offset.

properties.attribution: Kecskemét MJV Megalapozó Vizsgálat II., May2021 consultation draft, Figure78; geographical controls ©OpenStreetMap contributors.
reviewNotes: All source contour vertices and shared dividers are original black JPEG pixels; no missing source boundary is reconstructed.
Photographic texture supports a common Figure79/Figure78 image relation only within observed overlap. Southern, western and eastern contour portions extend beyond this observed overlap.

The original Figure79 five manual road-junction observations support a new metric calibration, but no independent physical validation covers the full extrapolated Figure78 footprint. Image matching cannot establish absolute boundary accuracy.
Current exact name scope, current/legal boundaries, source-map reuse rights and address assignment remain unverified.
